questions.question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Father, man, carpenter
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Man and Father:**

All **Fathers** are **Men**. This means the class of "Father" is entirely contained within the class of "Man".

However, there are some men who are not fathers.

**Carpenter and Man:**

Some **Men** are **Carpenters**, but some men are not.

Also, all carpenters are men.

Carpenter and Fathers:

Some **Fathers** are **Carpenters**, and some are not.

Also, some carpenters are fathers, and some are not.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a17bf95b25990f8d900245ab11924612157ab7cd3f66cd96ee746f37abd8250.png] 

So, **Figure 3 **shows **some** Fathers are Carpenters, and **some** Carpenters are Men, and **some** Fathers are Men who are also Carpenters.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Sohan bought a used motorbike for ₹20,000. What should its selling price be if he wants to make a 60% profit?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Cost price (CP) = ₹20,000
Profit % = 60%

Profit = 60% of 20,000
= 0.60 × 20,000
= ₹12,000

Selling price (SP) = CP + Profit
= 20,000 + 12,000
= **₹32,000**

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

questions.question:
Select the option of classes that is best represented by the given Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2ebfd56c2730df6f9a6b4a4bbed4471f966221aa677ff2f298098fd5d678486.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**1) Asia, Nepal, Kathmandu:**

**Nepal** is a country **in Asia**.

**Kathmandu** is the capital city **in Nepal**.

**2) father, son, husband:**

A man can be a **father** and a **husband** at the same time.

A man can be a **son** and a **husband** at the same time.

**3) pineapple, lychee, fruit:**

**Pineapple** is a **fruit**.

**Lychee** is a **fruit**.

**4) woman, doctor, wife:**

A **wife** is always a **woman**.

A **doctor** can be a **woman** or a **wife.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2ebfd56c2730df6f9a6b4a4bbed4471f966221aa677ff2f298098fd5d678486.png] 

So, Pineapple and Lychee are two entirely different types of fruit, meaning the class of pineapple and the class of lychee are separate with no common elements.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Which boxes will be formed when the given sheet of paper is folded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70605c9bdd9cbf3785d0811b31de614e82d9cbe29c4d400262240d05faf9aad1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/302ca6be00a931f53f8db6f0aeb0d9d064046aa6af93035ca03c99d41e63a475.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 

**Opposite faces can never be adjacent (visible together)** on a cube.

**Adjacent faces must be present together** in the folded cube.

*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/302ca6be00a931f53f8db6f0aeb0d9d064046aa6af93035ca03c99d41e63a475.png] 

**Box I: **the 'O' and the '+' faces are not opposite, and the 'O' and a Blank face are opposite, this arrangement is possible if the visible blank face is not* the one opposite to 'O'.

**Box II: ** The two **'+'** faces are **opposite** in the net and Opposite faces **cannot** be seen together.

**Box III: **If this box is formed, the face opposite to the visible '+' must be the other '+', which is hidden.

**Box IV: **The two '+' faces are **opposite**, so only one '+' can be visible.

Since, all three faces ('O', '+', and a Blank) are mutually adjacent in the net, **both Box I and Box IV are possible** folded cubes.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

questions.question:
Three of the following four words are similar in a certain way, and one is different. Select the odd one out.

I. Kidney

II. Leg

III. Hand

IV. Stomach
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Kidney, Leg, Hand** — each normally exists as a *pair* in the human body:

Kidneys: two (left and right), located retroperitoneally, each filters blood and produces urine.

Legs: two (left and right lower limbs), used for weight-bearing and locomotion.

Hands: two (left and right upper limbs’ terminal structures), used for manipulation and fine motor tasks.

**Stomach** — normally a *single* organ (one stomach) that functions as a primary site of mechanical and chemical digestion.

Because **kidney, leg, and hand** are normally present in *pairs* (left and right) while the **stomach** is normally *single*, **IV (Stomach)** is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**
